objective: Prove that loops of rings and two rings sharing contacts are on time at every size and check the Platonic networks exactly; give the square plane's late ring at distance 4; prove that a quotient of a tessellation is late whenever its medial systole is at least 2l + m, l the first late distance of the cover; with it classify the on-time square, triangular and honeycomb tori of every shape and chirality; and compute the first late distance of the covers of the flat and hyperbolic types (two primes, exact balls), with its patterns.
status: Proved 2026-11-08 (by hand; finite claims checked exactly; covers computed): every loop of rings, every pair of rings sharing contacts and every Platonic network is on time at every size; the square plane is late at distance 4, the triangular at 6, the honeycomb at 5; a quotient whose medial systole is at least 2l + m is late; so exactly 26 tori are on time (9 square of index at most 17, 11 triangular at most 21, 6 honeycomb at most 9, both chiralities) and the smallest late regular map is the twisted torus {4,4}_(2,3) of 13 rings, whose mirror image is on time. Computed: in every cover read the first tie of shortest routes comes at tau = L - L/m - L/f + 1 and the first late ring at tau + 1 (tau + 2 for triangular faces and larger rings).
title: Only the sphere reads distance plainly at every size
